items.title: Prediction: Apple Is Quietly Setting Up for a Huge 2026
items.summary: Apple just posted its ninth consecutive earnings beat and a record Services quarter, but the real question is whether the market has already priced in everything good that is coming, or whether the biggest catalyst is still being underestimated.

items.title: AMD Lost SpaceX to Nvidia. Is Its AI Challenge Already Falling Apart?
items.summary: SpaceX just handed NVIDIA a high-profile win by locking in 20% of its next platform, leaving AMD without a flagship logo at the worst possible moment. The real question is whether this signals a crack in Lisa Su's ambitions or just the cost of competing in a market built on scarcity and politics.

items.title: Is Apple Stock's 33.54X PE Still Worth it? Buy, Sell, or Hold?
items.summary: AAPL's 33.54X forward P/E tops its sector and peers, even as iPhone, Services and AI momentum support growth amid supply and currency headwinds.

items.title: IREN Jumps 6% but Then Gives Up Gains as Microsoft Accepts Horizon 1; TeraWulf Ticks Up, Cipher Digital Drops 5%
items.summary: Microsoft just signed off on a Texas data center that could flip IREN's bear case upside down, but the stock gave back its entire 6% surge within the first hour of trading. Here is what the acceptance milestone means for the bulls, the shorts, and the sector peers caught in the middle.

items.title: The Billionaire Investor Who Predicted Black Monday Was Recently Making Moves Around His Top 4 AI Stock Holdings
items.summary: Paul Tudor Jones has been taking a cautious view of the market, which can be seen in his portfolio.

items.title: The Trillion-Dollar AI Capex Gap: Why Too Much Hardware Could Be Nvidia’s Trap and Microsoft’s Opportunity
items.summary: The problem with AI valuations is that infrastructure spending is running far ahead of the revenue available to support it. Goldman Sachs estimates roughly $7.6 trillion in cumulative AI capital spending from 2026 through 2031. OpenAI and Anthropic, meanwhile, were generating combined annualized revenue of more than $105 billion by August 2026, which is impressive […]

items.title: Microsoft Spent $115.9 Billion on AI. What Did Shareholders Get?
items.summary: Microsoft just handed shareholders a dividend raise while simultaneously pouring more cash into AI infrastructure than most companies generate in revenue. Whether that historic spending spree is building long-term wealth or quietly squeezing the payout depends on what happens in September.

items.title: HRT Taps CoreWeave for NVIDIA Vera Rubin: Could This Be a Win for CRWV?
items.summary: CoreWeave's HRT deal taps NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform, expanding financial-services exposure and boosting visibility for specialized AI infrastructure demand.
